text:
Create a new corrected 12-pose run-loop sprite sheet based on the attached original Sora sheet. The attachment is the artwork/style reference; its motion has defects to fix. Preserve its smooth detailed KH2 Sora artwork, character identity, outfit, face/hair, rich folds, gloves and yellow/black shoes. No individual body/weapon layers: complete new drawings per pose.




Use exactly 4 columns by 3 rows, chronological left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Equal cells, generous plain white gutters, complete hair/shoes/chain/weapon inside every cell. No captions, numbers, grid lines, extra characters or scenery. Plain white background is acceptable; do not claim transparency if unavailable.




Keep fixed right-facing three-quarter view, character scale, limb lengths, shoe sizes and torso lean. Animate in place with stable horizontal registration and a common ground height. Small compression/flight bob is appropriate. Twelve distinct articulated hip/knee/ankle poses must alternate which leg supports the body: first half far-foot contact, compression, near-leg recovery/passing, far push-off, flight, near precontact; second half near-foot contact, compression, far-leg recovery/passing, near push-off, flight, far precontact. Avoid repeated same-leg strides, mirrored body substitutions or scaled copies. Last pose must lead naturally into first contact without duplicating it.




Critical correction: the near/front EMPTY arm must visibly swing both FORWARD and BACKWARD opposite the near leg, with natural elbow bending and consistent upper-arm/forearm/glove proportions. Include clearly visible backward elbow/fist silhouettes beside or behind the hip when the near leg reaches forward. Do not leave the empty fist extended forward in all twelve poses. Keep it below and clear of the blade; it never grips the weapon.




The opposite far/rear arm ALWAYS holds the Kingdom Key over its own far shoulder behind Sora's head. Preserve the reference carry orientation. One rigid connected weapon design throughout: identical handle, guard, shaft length/thickness, key head/teeth and attached chain. Keep grip/pommel/guard/shaft connected, wrist noninverted, no changing hands or shape/length. Minor coherent body movement and subtle cloth/chain lag only.




Check alternating supports, forward AND backward free-arm poses, stable proportions, consistent connected weapon, full cell fit and final-to-first continuity before returning the single new complete sheet. Do not replace this with video or just repeat the attachment.
